project.purpose: Migrate Ordivon Gateway deployment carrier from WSL/systemd to an independent Windows workstation control plane while preserving Gateway non-authoritative semantics and Runtime/Host natural-owner truth.

invariants: Runtime remains sole owner of Workspace/Job/Attempt/process/artifact physical truth.
Host remains sole owner of semantic continuity/collaboration truth.
Owner unavailability degrades only routed capabilities and must not terminate Gateway.
Windows Gateway must start and serve system/capability projection with WSL fully stopped.
Carrier migration must not create Gateway scheduler, Registry, Job store, Task store, or Artifact store.

baseline.regression: 54/54 PASS in R2 workspace with CPython 3.14.7; ruff PASS

nodes.label: BaselineFreeze
nodes.responsibility: Freeze source/live/connector/topology/release identities before mutation.

nodes.label: SemanticContractFreeze
nodes.responsibility: Preserve current 16-tool northbound schema, reference grammar, truth roles, and carrier-independent behavior.

nodes.label: OwnerRouteContract
nodes.responsibility: Keep four capability routes owner-derived and prevent domain-route scope creep.

nodes.label: WindowsToolchain
nodes.responsibility: Install pinned uv and uv-managed CPython 3.14.7 under candidate ProgramData root.
acceptance: uv 0.12.17 is installed under isolated ProgramData candidate root.
Installed uv.exe is byte-identical to the official 0.12.17 x86_64 Windows release archive.
uv-managed CPython 3.14.7 is installed under the candidate root.
No Windows Runtime executable allow-root was broadened.

nodes.label: WindowsReleaseLayout
nodes.responsibility: Materialize immutable Git-SHA Gateway releases with release-local .venv and exact lockfile.
acceptance: PowerShell parser reports zero errors on Windows.
Exact Git SHA 5bd241df24da3259c1c6e3637bf3fc513129e4b9 materializes as Gateway 0.3.0 with Python 3.14.7.
Release-local MCP probe reports the exact 16-tool current source surface.
Replay of the same source commit reuses the same release path and reports releaseCreated=false.
uv.lock and pyproject.toml digests are recorded in the release receipt.
UNC-backed WSL workspaces are admitted only with exact Git safe.directory binding and Git exit-code validation before parsing.

nodes.label: ServiceCarrierQualification
nodes.responsibility: Qualify current stable generic Windows service carrier; Shawl 1.9.0 primary candidate, WinSW reference.
acceptance: Shawl v1.9.0 official win64 archive digest matches GitHub release metadata.
shawl.exe reports version 1.9.0 and exposes no-restart, stop-timeout, kill-process-tree and cwd controls.
Temporary SCM service starts a parent and child process; SCM stop reaches Stopped and both processes are gone.
A child exiting nonzero under --no-restart is invoked exactly once and service reaches Stopped.
All qualification services are deleted after the experiment.

nodes.label: GatewayWindowsService
nodes.responsibility: Run Gateway candidate as independent Windows SCM service without owner dependencies.
acceptance: Historical R1 candidate acceptance is evidence only; current SCM instance must be rematerialized from R2 exact SHA and re-probed.
Unaccepted candidate defaults to Manual start; Automatic is a later lifecycle/cutover promotion.

nodes.label: ServiceIdentityAcl
nodes.responsibility: Use restricted service identity/service SID and protected resource-class ACLs.
acceptance: Service SID type is UNRESTRICTED.
Release and uv-managed Python trees grant service RX; logs M; credentials R; SYSTEM/Administrators retain FullControl.
Descendant files inherit the intended ACL instead of becoming ACL-empty.

nodes.label: CredentialCarrier
nodes.responsibility: Carry owner credential file references on Windows with startup ACL verification; never inline secrets.
acceptance: Windows credential carrier accepts file references only and never inline secret values.
Credential bytes are copied byte-for-byte into protected files; receipt contains digest/length, not secret content.
Windows Runtime credential can be materialized entirely inside Windows authority.
Linux Runtime credential handoff remains blocked until an approved secure operator-owned cross-boundary handoff exists.

nodes.label: WindowsGatewayConfig
nodes.responsibility: Translate existing ORDIVON_GATEWAY_* contract to Windows non-secret config/environment carrier.
acceptance: Candidate uses Windows-carried ORDIVON_GATEWAY_* configuration on port 18999.
Actual network MCP endpoint reports Gateway 0.3.0 and exact 16-tool current-source surface.
Uncredentialed Runtime owner probes degrade to available=false while Host remains available and Gateway stays healthy.

nodes.label: WindowsRuntimeRoute
nodes.responsibility: Route runtime.windows to local native Windows Runtime over loopback with owner authentication.

nodes.label: LinuxRuntimeRoute
nodes.responsibility: Route runtime.linux through existing Windows-to-WSL localhost forwarding; fail scoped when WSL is down.

nodes.label: HostRoute
nodes.responsibility: Route host through existing Windows-to-WSL localhost forwarding; fail scoped when Host/WSL is down.
acceptance: Windows candidate continuity.list directly reads Host state over the WSL loopback route.
continuity.external re-probes available=true after transient aggregate observation noise.

nodes.label: OwnerHealthProjection
nodes.responsibility: Keep Gateway alive while capability.describe reports per-owner availability/errors.

nodes.label: ArtifactRoute
nodes.responsibility: Preserve operation_ref-driven runtime.dynamic artifact reads without byte ownership.

nodes.label: NorthboundAuth
nodes.responsibility: Preserve Cloudflare Access assertion verification and canonical public-origin rules on Windows.

nodes.label: CloudflareIngress
nodes.responsibility: Point Windows-native cloudflared ingress to Windows Gateway candidate after local acceptance.

nodes.label: ConnectorCurrentness
nodes.responsibility: Converge source/deployed/public/ChatGPT connector tool catalogs; remove stale capability.list.

nodes.label: FailureMatrix
nodes.responsibility: Inject owner, WSL, Gateway and ingress faults and prove scoped degradation.

nodes.label: WindowsLifecycleAcceptance
nodes.responsibility: Prove SCM start/stop/restart/crash/cold-boot/ACL/release identity.
acceptance: Forced termination of the candidate SCM service process causes SCM recovery to a new PID.
Recovered candidate restores :18999 health=200, 16 tools, and Host continuity while remaining Manual.
Cold-boot acceptance remains open.

nodes.label: CanaryCutover
nodes.responsibility: Run WSL production and Windows candidate side-by-side and compare semantic outputs.

nodes.label: WslGatewayRetirement
nodes.responsibility: Move normal ingress to Windows Gateway then disable WSL Gateway only after destructive gates pass.

slices.objective: Freeze current truth and carrier-independent contracts.
acceptance: Current source regression green; source/live/connector drift explicitly recorded.

slices.objective: Build Windows substrate without creating a production service.
acceptance: Pinned toolchain and immutable release materialize under isolated ProgramData candidate root; service wrapper qualification passes.
Candidate service runs on non-production port with protected credentials and no owner lifecycle dependency.
blockers: GW09 credential materialization is blocked by platform safety; do not bypass.

acceptance: Windows, Linux and Host owner failures are independently observable.

slices.objective: Prove degraded capability projection and artifact routing.
acceptance: Gateway remains available when any owner is unavailable.
blockers: GW15 artifact route requires at least one authenticated Runtime owner

slices.objective: Attach public auth/ingress and converge consumer catalog.
acceptance: Source/deployed/public/connector schema parity and auth pass.

slices.objective: Destructively prove independence and lifecycle recovery.
acceptance: WSL-off test leaves Gateway + Windows Runtime usable; WSL return restores Linux/Host without Gateway restart.
blockers: Authenticated Windows Runtime survival and cold-boot acceptance remain; SCM crash recovery is proven.

slices.objective: Canary, cut over, retire old WSL carrier.
acceptance: Differential canary passes, public ingress moves, old WSL Gateway disabled without truth migration.

gaps: GW09/GW11 Windows Runtime bearer materialization is blocked by platform safety in the current agent path; do not bypass.
GW12 Linux Runtime bearer requires an approved secure operator-owned cross-boundary handoff.
ChatGPT connector exposes a stale 9-tool catalog while source/candidate expose 16 tools.
Public Cloudflare auth/ingress is not yet attached to the Windows candidate.
Cold-boot acceptance and authenticated artifact/execution routes remain open.

review.notes: Windows candidate ba3de6c2 remains live on :18999 in Manual mode with 16 tools. WSL-off independence and Host recovery without Gateway restart are proven. A forced SCM service-process crash recovered automatically from PID 19716 to PID 26640 with health 200 and Host continuity readback. Runtime routes remain auth-blocked because credential materialization is HUMAN_REQUIRED after the platform safety boundary rejected automated secret handoff; do not bypass. Cold-boot, authenticated Runtime/artifact routes, public canary, connector parity and cutover remain open.
